free_tier_limits: No free production tier. Paid plans only (Starter from $39/mo without API; Professional from $99/mo with API). 30-day free trial available; developer sandbox is for testing only (not free production access).
resolution_notes: free_tier: false — both verifiers correct. Official pricing (https://www.taxjar.com/pricing) lists only paid Starter ($39/mo) and Professional ($99/mo); API access is Professional-only (Starter shows N/A for API). A 30-day free trial exists but is not an ongoing free tier. free_tier_limits: Original "unknown" and Verifier A's confirm are wrong given free_tier=false; use N/A-style limits. Evidence: pricing compare table shows API access only on Professional; support (https://support.taxjar.com/article/139-how-much-does-taxjar-cost) states Professional is required for real-time API calculations. Sandbox (https://developers.taxjar.com/api/reference/) is testing-only, not free production.
